paragraphs.text: Desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes for DeepSeek Harness
# @mill413/dsh-notify
English | 中文说明
Desktop notifications and configurable HTTP pushes for DeepSeek Harness. Get a reminder when a task
stops running or needs approval, an answer, or plan review. Clicking a desktop notification returns
eds approval, an answer, or plan review. Clicking a desktop notification returns you to its session.
The published version is **0.4.2**, validated with npm **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3**. Other host versions have
not been verified. MIT licensed.
## Install
The plugin is published on npm; no source build is needed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use the DSH CLI that runs your target profile, with the same `DSH_HOME`. If you use Launcher, use it
s configured `DSH_LAUNCHER_DSH_COMMAND`. The package includes its bundle patch; do not edit the host
or profile manually.
Reload DSH and refresh the page after installation. On installations managed by `dsh-web.service`, r
estart that user service once installation is complete, then check its status.
## Notification channels
| Channel | Events | Requirements |
| Desktop notification | Main session stops running; new approval, question, or plan-review request

| Keep the DSH page open and allow browser notifications |
| HTTP push | Main agent changes from run
ning to idle; an agent requests approval or asks a question | Keep the DSH host running; the browser
agent requests approval or asks a question | Keep the DSH host running; the browser may be closed |
Subagent completion does not produce a separate completion alert; subagent approval and question req
uests do. Desktop notifications are sent only while the page is hidden or unfocused by default. This
restriction does not apply to HTTP pushes.
“Task complete” refers to a running-to-idle transition and does not guarantee success. The HTTP chan
nel does not subscribe to a separate plan-review event. Initial browser snapshots establish a baseli
ne and do not replay old alerts.
## Use

1. Open **Plugins → Desktop notifications (dsh-notify)** and expand its settings.
2. Grant browser n

otification permission, then send a test notification.
3. Choose completion, attention-needed and ba

ckground-only preferences, then save.
4. For HTTP delivery, configure your endpoint and request, tes
t it, then enable and save.
Desktop notifications and HTTP pushes have separate master switches. Completion and attention-needed
preferences are shared between the channels. The HTTP test uses the current unsaved form and works
while the channel is disabled.
## HTTP configuration
Requests run on the DSH host. An endpoint containing `localhost` refers to that machine. Supported m
ethods are `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `GET`; GET has no body. You may configure authentication heade
rs, a body template and an icon URL. Endpoint URLs must use HTTP(S) and cannot contain a username or
template and an icon URL. Endpoint URLs must use HTTP(S) and cannot contain a username or password.
Default body:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Template variables: `title` (session title), `body` (event summary), `event` (`complete`, `approval`
, `question`, or `test`), `level`, `group`, `sessionId`, `time` and `icon`. Unknown variables are le
ft unchanged. Substitution applies to body values, not URLs, headers or JSON keys. Valid JSON is par
sed before substitution and serialized afterwards; other bodies are treated as text without URL enco
efore substitution and serialized afterwards; other bodies are treated as text without URL encoding.
A request with a body defaults to `application/json` unless a Content-Type header is supplied. Reque
sts time out after five seconds. There is no retry or offline queue; HTTP 2xx is treated as successf
ul delivery to the configured endpoint, not proof of delivery to a recipient.
## Privacy and troubleshooting
HTTP delivery is disabled by default and has no built-in third-party destination. Only the endpoint
you configure receives requests. The default template sends the session title and event summary; the
plugin does not proactively send conversation contents. Credentials are stored with the plugin sett
ings in the DSH profile and are not encrypted by this plugin. Do not commit real request headers or
credential-bearing screenshots.
The test route uses DSH authentication. Users with access to it can ask the host to contact a config
ured HTTP address, including addresses on its network. Follow the host's access controls.
- Desktop notifications require HTTPS or a browser-recognized secure local context, browser permissi
on, and an open page. Check system Do Not Disturb and the background-only setting if no alert appear

s.
- This plugin uses the Notification constructor without a Service Worker. Some mobile browsers do

not support it. Use HTTP delivery when the browser will be closed.
- For HTTP failures, verify netw
ork reachability, request headers and receiver logs from the host machine, then use **Test push**.
## Development
Use Node.js 22.18.0 or newer and the package manager declared in `package.json`. SDK development dep
endencies come from npm and are pinned to the target DSH version; the repository does not depend on
an adjacent Harness checkout.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package includes host code, browser UI, locale files, its bundle patch and icon. The settings UI
supports Chinese and English; default HTTP titles and bodies are Chinese and can be customized thro
ugh the body template. See publishing instructions for the GitHub/npm release workflow.
